product_name: MDFlow EHR and Patient Care Workflow Management System
summary: C-CDA clinical summaries repackaged as EHI export, documented in just 205 words with zero data dictionary. Product's defining value-based care data (HCC/MRA, HEDIS, quality measures) unrepresentable in C-CDA. 58-page FHIR API docs vs. 2-page EHI stub says it all.
